title: LDV合伙人Winston Foo：寻找现代达芬奇，SpaceX的护城河有多深？
speaker: Winston Foo

segments.en: I can't speak for what people are looking at it today.
segments.zh: 我无法代表今天人们如何看待它。

segments.en: You've had lots of experts at Bloomberg himself talk about it.
segments.zh: 彭博社有很多专家在讨论。

segments.en: You know, we as early stage investors at LDV we always look for great entrepreneurs and a strong moat for the business.
segments.zh: 作为LDV的早期参与者，我们始终寻找优秀的企业家和强大的商业护城河。

segments.en: And so this has been an incredible ride.
segments.zh: 这是一段不可思议的旅程。

segments.en: And as you said, we're early stage investors.
segments.zh: 正如你所说，我们是早期参与者。

segments.en: LDV is named in honor of Leonardo da Vinci. And so we look to back modern day da Vinci's in the CEOs.
segments.zh: LDV以达芬奇命名，所以我们支持CEO中的现代达芬奇。
